summary: Still reproduces on main and on every stable release that can parse HLSL templates (v1.7.2308..v1.9.2607, 12 releases, no invalid probes inside that range); older releases reject 'template' as a reserved keyword and are invalid-probes, not clean results. Release binaries print the exact text quoted in the issue, byte-identical mangled name included; the Debug ground truth instead crashes earlier on an unrelated Debug-only assert in clang::LinkageComputer::getLVForDecl, confirmed (via cdb 'gh' continuation past that assert) to be the same defect reaching the identical Comdat text downstream. Both patterns the issue says already work (non-templated static member; templated const static member) still compile cleanly.
title: Non-const static data members of templated structs fail to compile
